szenen.vo: [shouting] Stop comparing yourself to everyone else, bro! [intense] It's killing your progress.
[intense] You only see their highlight reel. You never see their struggle.
[intense] They started years before you. Their chapter twenty is not your chapter one.
[intense] Stay in your lane. Your race is against one person only.
[shouting] The person you were yesterday! Beat that person, every single day!
[intense] No noise. No comparing. Just quiet work.
[intense] Stack small wins until nobody can ignore you.
[shouting] Run your own race, and win it!
